title: Mixed Event — Beyond The Dream of That Day

meta.Event: Beyond The Dream of That Day
meta.Outline: After putting on a successful solo show, MORE MORE JUMP! starts thinking about their next goal. During that time, they're offered a chance to appear on TV. Everyone is excited to hear the news, except Haruka, who doesn't quite share in their optimism...

rows.Line: Haruka's Room

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: “Thank you so much for putting on a solo show! I'm so happy to have been your fan and see you all come this far!”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: “I'm really looking forward to your next show! Please keep up the amazing work!”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: All of these letters are so heartwarming. It's really nice to see that everyone genuinely enjoyed our show...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I wasn't expecting that we'd receive this many... Thank goodness we decided to use an anonymous forwarding service.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Still, it's always nice to receive these...
Each person's handwriting is like an expression of their true feelings. Not only that...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Every envelope's really unique and cute.
The one covered in cat stickers must be for Airi, and this one's...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
A limited-edition snow Phenny...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Did they do this just for me?
I'll try opening it...

rows.Speaker: Fan Letter
rows.Line:
“Dear MMJ,
Congratulations on a successful solo show! I couldn't believe what I witnessed! I honestly thought I was dreaming!”

rows.Speaker: Fan Letter
rows.Line: “I've actually been a big fan since when you were still in ASRUN. Unfortunately, I wasn't allowed to go to any shows since I was still in elementary school.”

rows.Speaker: Fan Letter
rows.Line: “When I entered junior high school, I thought my chance finally came... But you retired before I could, which made me so sad...”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh no...

rows.Speaker: Fan Letter
rows.Line: “I'd sort of given up hope until I heard about your solo show. Seeing your dazzling smile in person made me so incredibly happy!”

rows.Speaker: Fan Letter
rows.Line: “Thanks to that, I know that I'm going to be able to do my best tomorrow!”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Doing your best tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Fan Letter
rows.Line: “You were the reason I started watching MMJ's streams, Haruka, and since I've come to love all of you, being able to see MMJ's first solo show live was beyond exhilarating...”

rows.Speaker: Fan Letter
rows.Line: “I want more and more people to learn about MMJ. Also...”

rows.Speaker: Fan Letter
rows.Line: “My dream now is to see MMJ perform at the Butokan! I can't wait for when you all get your big chance to perform on a big stage!”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
The Butokan...
That really is the dream. Not just for idols either. All artists.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Only the best of the best get to perform there, and our fans are hoping that we get to stand on that stage.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I was so overwhelmed the first time I did...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: ASRUN becoming popular enough to perform there in front of all those people made me realize just how much support they'd given us until that point...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We were really able to give them hope and believe in a better tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I want Minori to experience that moment one day...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There's no way we can right now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (You only get to perform at the Butokan after going through a judging process that requires artists to have a certain amount of name recognition and skill. And above all else, the ability to fill 15,000 seats.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (We're a couple of zeroes off since we just managed to put on a show for 700. I suppose the only way for us to get there is to gradually work our way up...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But is that going to be possible at our current pace...?
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, here are the ones I finished reading yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks, Haruka!
I can't wait to read more letters again today!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then, Haruka, I'll hand the ones I've finished reading over to you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: They were filled with so many kind words. Some were addressed to you, so I hope you get a chance to go through them.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Some of the ones I read were addressed to you, Shizuku. It's always fun to get the letters from your fans since they're so passionate.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, I see...!
I'll be looking forward to reading them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Still, I really wasn't expecting to get this kind of response. I mean, we got so many letters that we had to split them into piles for each of us to read.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, this is so amazing...
We've even been getting more emails and DMs than usual.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah.
And on top of all these kind messages...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We've even started receiving offers for work, including interviews for magazines and short radio segments.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I still can't believe it.
I mean, the only offer we received until now was to perform at that elementary school.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I have a feeling that it's because our show was picked up by some online news outlets.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The three of us are idols who left their last groups... In essence, we went off the beaten path and managed to put on a successful solo show without the support of an agency.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That definitely makes for a good headline, but the article itself was a bit fluffed up...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But that article helped increase our name recognition, so I'm very grateful.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Me too!
And since doing our solo show, our subscriber count has been skyrocketing!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's great that we're getting all this attention now, but...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This is actually a good opportunity for us to think about our roots and decide what we're going to do moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Now that we've taken the huge step of putting on a solo show, we need to figure out what our next big goal is gonna be... And what we're gonna do to make it happen...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Our next big goal and how to make it happen...

rows.Speaker: Fan Letter
rows.Line: “I want more and more people to learn about MMJ. Also...”

rows.Speaker: Fan Letter
rows.Line: “My dream now is to see MMJ perform at the Butokan! I can't wait for when you all get your big chance to perform on a big stage!”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sorry, would you mind if I fielded that?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, after I got home once our show was done, I searched online to see what people thought of it...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: One person said, “I want you girls to do shows everywhere,” and another, “I want more people to learn about you girls.”

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Quite a few of our fans also said that in their letters...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Exactly...
Which is why I'm thinking that we should try doing what they're asking...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's try performing in all sorts of different places and get people to know that MORE MORE JUMP! is here to stay.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's spread and inspire hope in as many people as we can!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: As many people as we can...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, I began thinking about how we could accomplish that...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Which is why I think MORE MORE JUMP! should go on tour!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A tour...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It doesn't stop there!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Once we've become famous enough to go on tour, I want us to do a show at the Dome.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I want to spread hope to everyone in Japan... Just like how ASRUN did with me when I saw them for the first time!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Th-That's pretty big talk...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
MORE MORE JUMP! ...at the Dome?!
I mean, that's the dream, but...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm not joking!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Seeing so many people smiling during our show filled me with so much joy... And it made me really glad that we never stopped trying.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
So, I'm gonna keep trying...
My feelings from before haven't changed. I want to spread hope to everybody we meet.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<They're such an amazing group. I want more people to know about them.>
<They just gotta keep advertising themselves. That should get the ball rolling in terms of their popularity.>
<I know it's easier said than done, but they should do a show at the Dome.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They all have such high hopes for us...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Our fans are hoping that we'll be able to stand on the biggest stage and spread hope to more and more people!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That's what made me think...
I... I want to...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I want to become the best at spreading hope to others!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, I want us to seriously try to become idols who are able to perform at Japan's biggest venues, like the Dome...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I want us to become top idols!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (That's right. I also...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Back then, I...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Performing at the Dome as top idols, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Uh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Of course, this is just me talking....

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, I want to hear what you all think!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I understand how you feel, Minori.
And I wouldn't expect any less from you...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think I'm right in saying that the three of us also want to spread hope to as many people as possible.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
However, going for the top...
I have a feeling that we're going to want to give that more thought given our current situation...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah...
That's a pretty lofty goal since we just finished putting on our first solo show.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Right... It just isn't that easy, huh?
I guess moving forward...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait, it's already this late?!
We need to get ready for our “Post Solo Show Stream”!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, look at the time...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, we'll pick this back up some other time. For now, let's get ready!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori, Shizuku, you two get the tripod ready! Haruka, you get the phone!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: O-Okay, got it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shizuku, let's get to work on the tripod!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Okay!
We just need to pull these legs out, yes? Hm? It feels stuck...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, Shizuku, you're pulling it the wrong way! It's gonna break if you do that!
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So many more people than usual tuned in to watch our “Post Solo Show Stream”!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We must be getting featured after seeing such a large increase in subscribers.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Some of our first-time viewers even wrote in the comments for us. I felt compelled to do my best to make sure they also got to enjoy themselves.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Same.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: However, an increase in viewership means having to think whether or not we can do the same stuff we've been doing moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Which is why I'd like to pick back up on the discussion we were having before our stream...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I-I'm really sorry!
My mom just asked me to go buy some ground beef at the store after she forgot...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Apparently, if I don't go, the meat sauce for our pasta's just going to consist of canned tomatoes!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That actually sounds good by itself, but it wouldn't be meat sauce without any meat. You probably should go run to the store for her.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'm super sorry!
I know we were about to have a really important discussion...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well, it is getting pretty late anyway, so don't worry about it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Th-Thanks...!
I promise to think more about our future goals once I get home!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Anyway, I need to get to the store!
See you all later!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, see you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Gone. Just like that...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Minori really is a big bundle of energy.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, but...
She really threw us a curveball there.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She did...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Our fans are hoping that we'll be able to stand on the biggest stage and spread hope to more and more people!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, I want us to seriously try to become idols who are able to perform at Japan's biggest venues, like the Dome...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I want us to become top idols!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The truth is, one of our fans said, “My dream now is to see MMJ perform at the Butokan!”

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: At the Butokan...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: When I saw that, a part of me said, “That'd be really amazing,” while another part of me went, “Not as we currently are.”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The three of us used to be in famous idol groups, and we're blessed to have fans who've been following us since that time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: However, that was then and this is now. Not all of our fans ended up making the transition, so there's no way we'll be able to fill 15,000 seats in our current state.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Which is why my jaw sort of dropped when I heard about us performing at the Dome...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah, Airi's right.
I felt the exact same way.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But despite that, I...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori's words made me realize that it's not about how many seats we can fill. The old me never worried about anything like that...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Back then, I just wanted to spread hope to as many people as I could.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, when we started our group, a part of me hoped that we'd get to perform at the Dome as MORE MORE JUMP! someday...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
But that's “someday”...
And I know it's far into the future.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah...
As idols, we've got a lot of work to do before we can perform there.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But it's a great goal...
I mean, what idol wouldn't want to perform at the Dome in front of a full house?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Exactly...
Again, what Minori said brought me to this realization.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Our goal is to spread and inspire hope in as many people as possible. That hasn't changed and it isn't going to anytime soon...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And if we keep doing our best, the Dome will be waiting for us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's go for it. Not “someday”. Now. Let's do everything we can to fill the biggest venue in Japan and spread hope to everyone we meet.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: As top idols.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's actually kinda funny since a lot of people have been saying that they couldn't get tickets for our solo show. In hindsight, 700 was probably too low.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Plus, that article gave our channel a huge subscriber boost...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I've been chatting with Saito about this, and she thinks that we can expect at least 2,000 for our next event. Maybe even 3,000.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's so many people...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I was under the impression that 1,000 within six months or so might be possible...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But based on those figures, that's a venue the size of Shibuya Hall...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, that place is within our range now since it seats 1,900.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
This is incredible...!
It's hard to believe that we're already in a position to do a show at Shibuya Hall...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We really couldn't have asked for a better start. Honestly, not many idol groups catch fire like this right out of the gates.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: However, the Dome seats 30,000. In our current state, there's just no way... But...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As long as we maintain this momentum, we'll get there. So...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's keep doing our best!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah!
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm so sorry about what happened yesterday! I feel awful about leaving since we were about to have a really important discussion!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That's okay.
Did dinner go okay last night?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yup!
The meat sauce turned out great and the pasta was delicious! So I really appreciate you guys letting me go!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
A-Anyway...
Is it okay if we pick up where we left off yesterday...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, of course!
There's actually something we need to tell you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, after you left, the three of us had a little discussion regarding our future...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Including what you said about us becoming top idols...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Really?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um... How did you all feel about that...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We found that we're all in favor.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: To be perfectly honest, we weren't sure if we should have such a lofty goal since we just finished putting on our first solo show.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: However, you made us realize something.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Spreading hope to the people who come to see us is important, but so is doing that for everybody in Japan.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Let's do it.
Let's try to become idols who are worthy of performing at the Dome.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
However, that's easier said than done.
We're still just getting started as an idol group and are gonna need to jump through a lot of hoops to get there.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Right. At the same time...
It makes me want to work harder with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Me too. Not only that...
I see no problem with us having a dream since it's an idol's duty to spread hope and inspire dreams.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And I'm sure our fans will feel very inspired if we find a way to make our dream come true.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, let's do it...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's become top idols, spread hope to as many people as we can and inspire them to dream!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: After reading about how everyone felt about our show and thinking that we could become the best, a part of me began to wonder if I was getting way too ahead of myself...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I really want to pursue that goal and I don't want to give up on it...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Which is why I'm really glad that I worked up the courage to bring it up with all of you. And hearing that you're all in favor of it made me so happy!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Let's become top idols!
Together!

rows.Speaker: Haruka, Shizuku & Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, now that we've decided to try to become top idols in order to be able to perform at the Dome...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We'll need to start thinking about how we're actually going to accomplish that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Right!
Performing at the Dome's way in the future...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Until then, we should probably perform in shows at increasingly bigger venues. Those should work as stepping stones, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, about that...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We were actually thinking that we may be able to put on a show at a slightly bigger venue.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah.
For example, Shibuya Hall.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What? Shibuya Hall...? As in THE Shibuya Hall?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That'd be amazing...!
We'd be able to perform in front of so many people!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: At the same time, if we think we can fill 2,000 seats, we could start aiming a little higher.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Higher...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We have a big dream now, so if we are aiming to have 10,000 guests... That's about how many the Ryogoku Sumo Arena or Nonogi Gymnasium seat.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: 15,000 would mean the Butokan.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The Butokan...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Someone said that they want to see us perform there, right...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Us performing there would mean making their dream come true.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
So, I want to aim for that.
If we're going to perform at the Dome, we should try to perform at the Butokan first.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
15,000 people...
It's a huge number, but that's what we gotta go for if we want to be #1!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But that means we'll need to figure out a way to increase our audience size from 700 to 15,000.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: How do we actually go about doing that...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Our fan base should grow as long as we keep doing streams... However, 15,000 is going to be difficult to reach based on our current rate.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Does that mean we have to start rethinking how we do our streams? Especially since that one article gave us such a big boost!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We have a few options to choose from now, including magazines, radio...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
That's right. We got some offers for work!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, we did...
Those may benefit us quite a bit!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I agree for the most part...
However, we should do some research on each company before we accept any offers.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Right.
We received a lot of messages, but some seemed pretty sketchy.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Why don't we take this opportunity to go through them and get ourselves organized...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay...!
This is so exciting! I can't wait to see who's been trying to reach us since I haven't had a chance to look through all of them...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'll check the emails. Minori, can you take the DMs? Airi, if you could look through the comments for our streams...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
And Shizuku...
Would you mind assisting Minori and Airi?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, I get to be their assistant?
That sounds like fun!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Alright, Shizuku, I'm gonna need all the help you can give me!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, let's get started.

rows.Speaker: Airi, Shizuku & Minori
rows.Line:
Okay!
Yeah!
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, the next DM says...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
<Dear MORE MORE JUMP!
I'd like to congratulate you all for successfully putting on your first solo show! I was very impressed that you had put on the event all on your own!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <As it so happens, my company produces a diet supplement called “Super Weight Loss Beauty DX” which allows you to lose 30 kg by taking it each day, and we'd like for you to all advertise it...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: L-Lose 30 kg?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Won't you vanish into thin air if you take enough of those...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You know it's a straight-up scam, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If you wanna lose weight, you gotta eat right and get plenty of exercise. There's no such thing as magic diet pills.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
R-Right...
For a second there, I was amazed by how a product like that might be out there.

rows.Speaker: Airi
